description: The Public Service Commission - Notify the Second Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sports Development that Published on the Gaz.Ex.No. 1986/02 dated 26.09.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Service Minute (service regulations) for officers in the Combined Service of Officers in the field of Sports of the Department of Sports Development. It specifically deals with qualification requirements, recruitment conditions, salary increments, and promotion procedures for public service positions (Sports Coach and Executive Service Category). This falls under public sector service administration, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) as it concerns public service recruitment, qualifications, and career progression matters.
